sql: SELECT "foreign_data"."name", "cards"."asciiName" FROM "foreign_data" JOIN "cards" ON "foreign_data"."uuid" = "cards"."uuid" WHERE "cards"."cardKingdomFoilId" = '123100' ORDER BY "foreign_data"."name" ASC, "cards"."asciiName" ASC LIMIT 20
SELECT "rulings"."date" AS group_value, AVG("cards"."isOversized") AS aggregate_value FROM "rulings" JOIN "cards" ON "rulings"."uuid" = "cards"."uuid" GROUP BY "rulings"."date"
SELECT "text" FROM "rulings" WHERE "date" = '2010-03-01' ORDER BY "text" ASC LIMIT 20

SELECT "rulings"."date", "cards"."name" FROM "rulings" JOIN "cards" ON "rulings"."uuid" = "cards"."uuid" WHERE "cards"."cardKingdomId" = '122754' ORDER BY "rulings"."date" ASC, "cards"."name" ASC LIMIT 20

SELECT "foreign_data"."type" AS group_value, SUM("cards"."faceConvertedManaCost") AS aggregate_value FROM "foreign_data" JOIN "cards" ON "foreign_data"."uuid" = "cards"."uuid" GROUP BY "foreign_data"."type" ORDER BY aggregate_value DESC, group_value ASC LIMIT 5
SELECT "legalities"."status" AS group_value, AVG("cards"."convertedManaCost") AS aggregate_value FROM "legalities" JOIN "cards" ON "legalities"."uuid" = "cards"."uuid" GROUP BY "legalities"."status"
SELECT "flavorName" FROM "cards" WHERE "edhrecRank" = 12619 ORDER BY "flavorName" ASC LIMIT 20

SELECT DISTINCT p."availability" FROM "cards" AS p WHERE p."availability" IS NOT NULL AND p."uuid" IN (SELECT c."uuid" FROM "foreign_data" AS c WHERE c."language" = 'Chinese Simplified') ORDER BY p."availability" ASC LIMIT 20

SELECT "set_translations"."setCode", "sets"."mcmName" FROM "set_translations" JOIN "sets" ON "set_translations"."setCode" = "sets"."code" WHERE "sets"."tcgplayerGroupId" = 46 ORDER BY "set_translations"."setCode" ASC, "sets"."mcmName" DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT "legalities"."status" AS group_value, SUM("cards"."faceConvertedManaCost") AS aggregate_value FROM "legalities" JOIN "cards" ON "legalities"."uuid" = "cards"."uuid" GROUP BY "legalities"."status"
SELECT "status" FROM "legalities" WHERE "format" = 'penny' ORDER BY "status" ASC LIMIT 20

SELECT "set_translations"."setCode", "sets"."mcmName" FROM "set_translations" JOIN "sets" ON "set_translations"."setCode" = "sets"."code" WHERE "sets"."mtgoCode" = '10E' ORDER BY "set_translations"."setCode" ASC, "sets"."mcmName" DESC LIMIT 20
